findings.message: "$this" can no longer be used in a plain function or method since PHP 7.1. (existing bug, not caused by the upgrade: $this outside an object fails on every PHP version)
"$this" can no longer be used in a plain function or method since PHP 7.1. (existing bug, not caused by the upgrade: $this outside an object fails on every PHP version)

Guarded (only runs when the old feature is available, so it is skipped on newer PHP): Passing E_USER_ERROR to trigger_error() is deprecated since 8.4. Throw an exception or call exit with a string message instead.
